    depot = instance["depot_index"]
    customers = list(instance["customer_ids"])
    demands = instance["demands"]
    capacity = instance["capacity"]
    matrix = instance["distance_matrix"]
    vehicle_hint = instance.get("vehicle_count_hint", len(customers))

    def route_load(rt):
        s = 0
        for v in rt:
            s += demands[v]
        return s

    def route_cost(rt):
        if not rt:
            return 0
        c = matrix[depot][rt[0]]
        for i in range(len(rt) - 1):

        c += matrix[rt[-1]][depot]
        return c

            parent[c] = idx

    # Compute savings pairs
    pairs = []
    cs = customers
    for a_i in range(n):
        i = cs[a_i]
        di = matrix[depot][i]
        for b_i in range(a_i + 1, n):
            j = cs[b_i]
            s = di + matrix[depot][j] - matrix[i][j]
            # deterministic tie-break: larger savings first, then smaller i, then smaller j
            pairs.append((s, i, j))
    pairs.sort(key=lambda x: (-x[0], x[1], x[2]))

    def can_merge(ri, rj):
        if not (active[ri] and active[rj]):
            return False
        if ri == rj:
            return False
        return rload[ri] + rload[rj] <= capacity

    # Merge routes using only end-to-end concatenations
    route_count = n
    for s, i, j in pairs:
        if route_count <= vehicle_hint:
            break
        ri = parent[i] if i < len(parent) else -1
        rj = parent[j] if j < len(parent) else -1
        if ri == -1 or rj == -1:
            continue
        if not can_merge(ri, rj):
            continue

        # Cases:
        # last(ri)=i and first(rj)=j -> ri + rj
        if active[ri] and active[rj] and last[ri] == i and first[rj] == j:
            routes[ri] = routes[ri] + routes[rj]
        # last(ri)=i and last(rj)=j -> ri + reverse(rj)
        elif last[ri] == i and last[rj] == j:
            routes[ri] = routes[ri] + routes[rj][::-1]

        elif first[ri] == i and last[rj] == j:
            routes[ri] = routes[ri][::-1] + routes[rj][::-1]
        else:
            continue

        routes[rj] = []
        active[rj] = False
        rload[ri] += rload[rj]
        first[ri] = routes[ri][0]
        last[ri] = routes[ri][-1]
        route_count -= 1

        # Update parent mapping for moved customers in rj

    seen = set()

            continue
        ok = True
        for v in rt:
